name: Absorption native Great Work API availability on the saved PR87 game

steps.code:
local A=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_Absorption)
local selected,first=nil,nil
for _,owner in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveIDs()) do
 local ok,slots=pcall(A.OwnedGreatWorkSlots,owner)
 if ok and #slots>0 then selected=owner;first=slots[1];break end
end
selected=selected or Game.GetLocalPlayer()
local ok,core=pcall(A.NativeWorkCapabilities,selected)
local result={SelectedOwner=selected,FirstWork=first,GameplayOK=ok,Gameplay=ok and core or nil,GameplayError=not ok and tostring(core) or nil,UI={}}
for _,pair in ipairs({{'RequestPlayerOperation',UI},{'RequestPlayerOperation',Game},{'GetWorkingDeal',DealManager},{'GetPossibleDealItems',DealManager}}) do
 local name,object=pair[1],pair[2]
 local present,value=pcall(function() return object and object[name] end)
 result.UI[#result.UI+1]={Object=object==UI and 'UI' or object==Game and 'Game' or 'DealManager',Method=name,Available=present and type(value)=='function'}
end
for _,name in ipairs({'MOVE_GREAT_WORK','PARAM_PLAYER_ONE','PARAM_CITY_SRC','PARAM_CITY_DEST','PARAM_BUILDING_SRC','PARAM_BUILDING_DEST','PARAM_GREAT_WORK_INDEX','PARAM_SLOT'}) do
 result.UI[name]=PlayerOperations and PlayerOperations[name]~=nil or false
end
print('[JAC_NATIVE_WORK_API] '..A.Canonical(result))
return A.Canonical(result)
